defmodule FirmwareAuth.OAuthController do
  @moduledoc """
  OAuth 2.0 authorization controller for IoT device firmware updates.
  Handles cross-service authentication between device management portal
  and firmware distribution service.
  """

  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  @allowed_hosts MapSet.new(["firmware.iotdevice.com", "portal.iotdevice.com", "api.iotdevice.com"])
  @client_id "iot_firmware_service_v2"
  @token_endpoint "https://auth.iotdevice.com/oauth/token"

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  defp normalize_redirect_uri(uri) do
    parsed = URI.parse(uri)
    normalized_host = parsed.host
      |> to_string()
      |> String.downcase()
      |> String.trim_trailing(".")
    %URI{parsed | host: normalized_host}
  end

  defp validate_redirect_host(uri_struct) do
    host = uri_struct.host
    # Check if the host exactly matches our allowed list
    MapSet.member?(@allowed_hosts, host)
  end

  defp validate_scheme(uri_struct) do
    uri_struct.scheme in ["https"]
  end

  defp validate_no_credentials(uri_struct) do
    is_nil(uri_struct.userinfo)
  end

  defp encode_state(device_id, nonce) do
    payload = :erlang.term_to_binary({device_id, nonce, System.system_time(:second)})
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, get_signing_key(), payload)
    |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
    |> then(fn mac -> Base.url_encode64(payload, padding: false) <> "." <> mac end)
  end

  defp verify_state(state_param) do
    case String.split(state_param, ".", parts: 2) do
      [payload_b64, mac_b64] ->
        with {:ok, payload} <- Base.url_decode64(payload_b64, padding: false),
             {:ok, expected_mac} <- Base.url_decode64(mac_b64, padding: false) do
          actual_mac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, get_signing_key(), payload)
          if :crypto.hash_equals(actual_mac, expected_mac) do
            {device_id, nonce, timestamp} = :erlang.binary_to_term(payload, [:safe])
            if System.system_time(:second) - timestamp < 300 do
              {:ok, device_id, nonce}
            else
              {:error, :expired}
            end
          else
            {:error, :invalid_mac}
          end
        else
          _ -> {:error, :decode_failed}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :malformed}
    end
  end

  defp get_signing_key do
    case Application.get_env(:firmware_auth, :state_signing_key) do
      key when is_binary(key) and byte_size(key) >= 32 ->
        key

      _ ->
        raise "Missing or weak :state_signing_key configuration for :firmware_auth. " <>
              "A securely generated key of at least 32 bytes must be configured."
    end
  end

  get "/oauth/authorize" do
    conn = Plug.Conn.fetch_query_params(conn)
    redirect_uri = conn.query_params["redirect_uri"] || ""
    device_id = conn.query_params["device_id"] || ""
    scope = conn.query_params["scope"] || "firmware:read"

    uri_struct = normalize_redirect_uri(redirect_uri)

    with true <- validate_scheme(uri_struct),
         true <- validate_no_credentials(uri_struct),
         true <- validate_redirect_host(uri_struct) do

      nonce = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
      state = encode_state(device_id, nonce)

      auth_params = URI.encode_query(%{
        "response_type" => "code",
        "client_id" => @client_id,
        "redirect_uri" => redirect_uri,
        "state" => state,
        "scope" => scope
      })

      auth_url = "https://auth.iotdevice.com/oauth/authorize?" <> auth_params

      conn
      |> put_resp_header("location", auth_url)
      |> send_resp(302, "")
    else
      _ ->
        Logger.warning("Rejected redirect_uri: #{redirect_uri}")
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "invalid_redirect_uri"}))
    end
  end

  get "/oauth/callback" do
    conn = Plug.Conn.fetch_query_params(conn)
    code = conn.query_params["code"] || ""
    state = conn.query_params["state"] || ""
    redirect_uri = conn.query_params["redirect_uri"] || ""

    with {:ok, device_id, _nonce} <- verify_state(state),
         {:ok, token_response} <- exchange_code(code, redirect_uri) do

      # Redirect back to the device portal with the access token
      final_uri = normalize_redirect_uri(redirect_uri)

      # Re-validate the redirect on callback to prevent token theft
      if validate_redirect_host(final_uri) and validate_scheme(final_uri) do
        token = token_response["access_token"]
        final_url = URI.to_string(final_uri) <> "?token=" <> token <> "&device_id=" <> device_id

        conn
        |> put_resp_header("location", final_url)
        |> send_resp(302, "")
      else
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "invalid_callback_redirect"}))
      end
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("OAuth callback failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "authentication_failed"}))
    end
  end

  defp exchange_code(code, redirect_uri) do
    body = URI.encode_query(%{
      "grant_type" => "authorization_code",
      "code" => code,
      "redirect_uri" => redirect_uri,
      "client_id" => @client_id,
      "client_secret" => get_client_secret()
    })

    case HTTPoison.post(@token_endpoint, body, [{"Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}]) do
      {:ok, %HTTPoison.Response{status_code: 200, body: resp_body}} ->
        {:ok, Jason.decode!(resp_body)}
      {:ok, %HTTPoison.Response{status_code: status}} ->
        {:error, {:token_exchange_failed, status}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp get_client_secret do
    Application.get_env(:firmware_auth, :client_secret)
  end
end
